games.name: TIMELESS
games.desc:
During a violent outbreak in Robloxia, an Agency has been created to keep the remaining survivors safe. Your mission is to team up with your fellow emissaries to investigate dangerous areas. But be careful, and use your skills to your advantage.

TIMELESS is a 1v8 asymmetrical horror game that revolves around general Roblox media. The game takes big inspiration from The Disaster by OutLaikRBLX, and Left 4 Dead.
WARNING: This game contains flashing/bright lights

[KEYBINDS]:

[PC]
-Q, F, R, T : Using Abilities
-Left Control : Toggle ShiftLock
-V : Toggle POV
-R : Revive
-C : Carry
-G : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

[CONTROLLER]
-Y, L1, R1, L3 : Using Abilities
-L2 : Sprinting
-DPadUp : Toggle ShiftLock
-B : Revive
-DPadRight : Carry
-DPadDown : Emote
-X : Open/Close chat wheel

(Keybinds can be edited in settings)

games.name: Absolvement [ALPHA]
games.desc:
An end of a lifetime, or the beginning of an era? Nobody knows what lies at the end. In fact, most believe there is no end. You struggle to differentiate between your true memories and false ones planted from your fleeting consciousness as you shatter your body but not your soul.

<> Absolvement is currently in the ALPHA development stage. <>
Fundamentals of the game may change as we release updates!

- Play solo or in parties up to 5 players
- Branded by sins, affixes, and burdens - freely choose your rate of progression and your own personal difficulty
- Classless character design and progression
- Over 130 abilities to use and build synergies with
- Earn Soul Fragments when your character wipes to unlock 200+ buffs in the Soul Tree for your next character

Absolvement is a roguelite dungeon crawler developed by Amorian Skies.
Nominated in the 2025 Creator Awards for Best Narrative.
All in-game music is our own composed OST! 
Playable on PC and Console with controller support.
